entries.name: Octane Car Service
entries.description: General car servicing centre recommended in the group.

entries.description: Go-to independents for Land Rover / Range Rover owners in the group.

entries.name: Rideskipper
entries.description: Airport transfers and driver bookings. A repeat member favourite: professional, safe and reliable.

entries.name: eMovers
entries.description: Local Dubai movers recommended in the group.

entries.name: Call My Doctor
entries.description: Doctor-on-call service for home visits.

entries.name: Frank's Chippy

entries.name: Fire Feast Catering
entries.description: Catering run by a BILD member. Recommended for events and gatherings.

entries.name: Yalla Habibi

entries.name: Cosmos Insurance Brokers
